summary: Iter79 — Voice booking feature tested end-to-end. Backend voice endpoint works (9/11 new tests pass; 2 reveal a real bug). FULL regression 100/100. UI: FAB/sheet/examples/transcript/submit all work and API returns 200 with correct parsed JSON (intent=book_taxi, pickup=Gare du Nord, dropoff=Tour Eiffel, confidence=0.97). CRITICAL bug found: VoiceAssistant.js navigates to /ride/book which matches the route /ride/:rideId with rideId='book' → user lands on a 'Course introuvable' (Ride not found) page instead of the booking form. The actual booking route is /ride (App.js line 188). As a consequence the prefill useEffect never runs, no pickup/dropoff is set, and the 'Réservation pré-remplie par la voix' toast never appears.

critical.issue: Confidence falsy-zero bug. In routes/voice.py line 112, `float(parsed.get('confidence') or 0.6)` converts confidence=0.0 → 0.6 because 0.0 is falsy in Python. This (a) inflates the confidence of unknown-intent phrases (e.g. 'Quelle est la météo demain à Paris ?' returns confidence 0.6 from the LLM path) and (b) overrides the fallback's own 0.0 confidence for non-taxi intents. Fix: `parsed.get('confidence') if parsed.get('confidence') is not None else 0.6`. Same anti-pattern applies to other `or` defaults if 0/empty are legitimate values.

minor.issue: voice_bookings collection is written on every call (including malformed/unknown intents). Consider only logging useful records or capping size for cleanup.

Regex `r"\\b(?:de|du)\\s+([^,]+?)\\s+(?:à|au|jusqu['e]à?)\\s+(.+)$"` uses `['e]` which means 'apostrophe or e' — almost certainly intended `[''e]` (curly apostrophe or e). Edge case: 'jusqu'à' typed with straight quote still matches via the `e` branch, but with a curly apostrophe it won't.

ui_bugs.issue: navigate('/ride/book', ...) lands on /ride/:rideId with rideId='book' → shows 'Course introuvable'. The actual booking route is /ride (App.js:188). Fix: change `/ride/book` → `/ride` (and `/runner` → verify exists; if not, choose correct path).

integration_issues.issue: Because the target route is wrong, the prefill useEffect on RideBookingPage never executes. Even when /ride/book is fixed to /ride, the geocode path requires window.google.maps.Geocoder; if Google Maps script is still loading when the user lands, geocode returns null silently and no toast fires. Add a retry/wait-for-google strategy or render a loading state.

issues: FAB position (bottom-24 right-5 z-900) overlaps with the bottom tab bar in some viewport heights — fine on 390x844 but worth verifying on smaller phones (e.g. iPhone SE 375x667).

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceAssistant.js line 84, change navigate target from '/ride/book' to '/ride' (and verify '/runner' route exists; if not, pick a real one).

HIGH: Fix confidence default in /app/backend/routes/voice.py _normalize: replace `float(parsed.get('confidence') or 0.6)` with `float(parsed['confidence']) if parsed.get('confidence') is not None else 0.6`.
Optional: ensure RideBookingPage prefill waits for window.google.maps before geocoding (loop until available or use a Maps loader promise).
Optional: clean the dictionary character class in fallback regex (line 130) — use `[’']` instead of `['e]` (likely typo).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/voice.py:112 — falsy-zero bug on `confidence`. Real impact: unknown intent phrases (LLM returns 0.0) get 0.6 and pass the frontend's 0.3 threshold; only the parallel `intent=='unknown'` guard saves the UX.

routes/voice.py:108 — same pattern: `vehicle_type` defaults to 'vtc-taxi' only when intent=='book_taxi' which is fine, but `passengers` `or 1` would turn passengers=0 (invalid) silently into 1 — minor.
VoiceAssistant.js:84 — `/ride/book` is a dead route. Should be `/ride`. This is the single biggest bug from this iteration and it makes the whole voice→booking flow unusable.
VoiceAssistant.js:174 — data-testid uses `ex.slice(0,10)` which yields collisions if two examples share the same 10-char prefix; today they don't, but it's fragile.

RideBookingPage.js:78-123 — useEffect dependency `[location.state]` may re-trigger geocoding if React re-creates the state object on re-render. Consider keying on a stable hash (e.g. JSON.stringify(prefill)) or running once with a ref guard.
voice.py — no rate limiting / per-user quota. Each call hits Claude Sonnet; a user could spam the endpoint and burn the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (UI render + API integration perfect, but navigation target wrong → flow dead-ends on Course introuvable page)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes (a) VoiceAssistant navigate target '/ride/book' → '/ride', and (b) the _normalize falsy-zero on confidence, rerun: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iter79_voice.py -v ; then UI smoke: login as test2 → /home → click voice FAB → click first example → click 'Réserver maintenant' → expect /ride to load with pickup='Gare du Nord' and dropoff='Tour Eiffel' filled AND a toast 'Réservation pré-remplie par la voix'.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the dead-end after submit: VoiceAssistant.js was written assuming a /ride/book route, but App.js exposes /ride for booking and /ride/:rideId for tracking. React Router matches /ride/book against /ride/:rideId with rideId='book', sending the user to RideTrackingPage which tries GET /api/rides/book → 404 → renders 'Course introuvable'. Reproduction: login as test2 → /home → click voice mic FAB → click any example pill → click 'Réserver maintenant' (API returns 200 with parsed payload) → URL becomes /ride/book and screen shows 'Course introuvable / Retour'. Mitigation: one-line change in VoiceAssistant.js line 84 (`/ride/book` → `/ride`). The prefill effect in RideBookingPage.js already reads location.state.prefill so once the route is correct the toast and address fields should populate (assuming Google Maps script loaded).
